title: Molecular basis of nick ligation in the nucleosome by DNA Ligase IIIalpha.
authors: Boesch, Daniel J; Martin, Nadia I; Kontor, Chantal A; Nguyen, Ashlee G; Tomkinson, Alan E; Van Houten, Bennett; Gillet, Natacha; Bignon, Emmanuelle; Whitaker, Amy M; Weaver, Tyler M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA连接酶IIIalpha在核小体上修复单链断裂的分子机制，虽涉及染色质和分子动力学模拟，但核心是DNA修复而非三维基因组/染色质组织建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Genomic DNA is packaged into chromatin through a fundamental repeating unit known as the nucleosome core particle. Chromatinized genomic DNA is constantly exposed to endogenous and exogenous stresses that result in DNA damage, which must be repaired to maintain genome stability. Single-strand breaks (SSBs) are a prevalent form of DNA damage that arise via the oxidation-induced disintegration of the sugar-phosphate backbone or as repair intermediates during base excision repair. DNA ligase IIIalpha (LigIIIalpha) is one of the primary enzymes responsible for repairing ligatable SSBs during the terminal step of single-strand break repair (SSBR) and base excision repair (BER). To date, a mechanistic description of how LigIIIalpha processes nicks within chromatin remains elusive. Here, we use a combination of biochemical assays, molecular dynamics simulations, and cryogenic electron microscopy to define the molecular basis of nick ligation in the nucleosome by LigIIIalpha, providing foundational insight into the terminal step of chromatin-based SSBR/BER.
abstract_zh: 基因组DNA通过被称为核小体核心颗粒的基本重复单元包装成染色质。染色质化的基因组DNA持续暴露于内源性和外源性应激，导致DNA损伤，这些损伤必须被修复以维持基因组稳定性。单链断裂（SSBs）是DNA损伤的一种常见形式，源于糖-磷酸骨架的氧化诱导解体或作为碱基切除修复过程中的修复中间体。DNA连接酶IIIα（LigIIIalpha）是负责在单链断裂修复（SSBR）和碱基切除修复（BER）的末端步骤中修复可连接SSBs的主要酶之一。迄今为止，关于LigIIIalpha如何在染色质内处理切口的机制描述仍然缺乏。在此，我们结合生化实验、分子动力学模拟和冷冻电子显微镜，定义了LigIIIalpha在核小体中进行切口连接的分子基础，为基于染色质的SSBR/BER末端步骤提供了基础性见解。
